title.en: What a list holds: kept at its length, kept for good
title.zh: 列表所容：至其长而存，则恒存

statement.en: Where a list holds every member of a start that a monotone step takes into itself, what is in the iterate at the list's length is in every iterate, and is the largest class in the start the step preserves. Keeping under every course, along some course, by choice and through a reading are cases.
statement.zh: 单调之步把起始类带入其自身，且一列表容纳起始类的每个成员时：在列表长度处之迭代中的，就在每一迭代中，且它是起始类之内该步所保持的最大类。每条进程下的保持、沿某条进程的保持、凭选择的保持与经由读取的保持，皆为其例。

laws.en: For a monotone step on classes that takes its start into itself, where a list holds every member of the start: a state in the iterate at the list's length is in the next iterate, so in every iterate, and that iterate is the largest class inside the start that the step preserves. With no list, a class inside the start that the step preserves lies in every iterate.
laws.zh: 单调之步把起始类带入其自身，且一列表容纳起始类的每个成员时：在列表长度处之迭代中的状态也在下一迭代中，故在每一迭代中；该迭代是起始类之内该步所保持的最大类。无需列表：起始类之内为该步所保持的类，在每一迭代之中。

laws.en: For a monotone step whose start is the step applied to the class of everything, where a list of length n + 1 holds every state, a state in iterate n is in iterate n + 1.
laws.zh: 单调之步的起始类即该步作用于全体之类，且长为 n + 1 的列表容纳每个状态时：在第 n 迭代中的状态也在第 n + 1 迭代中。

laws.en: Where a list holds every state at which a requirement holds: it holds throughout a relation's closure from a state exactly where that state is in the iterate at the list's length, from the requirement, of the step asking it here and every successor in the class. So for the kernel of every process and for lasting, under every admissible disturbance, for as many steps as the list is long; one step sooner where a list of length n + 1 holds every state.
laws.zh: 一列表容纳要求成立之处的每个状态时：该要求在一关系之闭包中自某状态起处处成立，恰当该状态在自该要求起、于列表长度处的迭代之中，其步要求此处满足且每个后继皆在类中。每个过程之核如此；在每一可容许扰动下持续与列表等长的步数亦如此；长为 n + 1 的列表容纳每个状态时，早一步即然。

laws.en: Where a list holds every configuration: from where a course of as many steps as the list is long starts, some step leads to where another such course starts, and courses of every length start there.
laws.zh: 一列表容纳每个构形时：自与列表等长之进程的起点，有一步通向另一条这样的进程的起点，且每一长度的进程皆自此起。

laws.en: Where a list holds every configuration within a guard: a configuration viable for as many steps as the list is long has an enabled move all of whose outcomes are viable for as many; such configurations form a closed set; and being viable for that many steps is being viable for every number of steps, and is lying in some closed set.
laws.zh: 一列表容纳守卫之内的每个构形时：可存续与列表等长步数的构形，有一可行之动，其每个结果皆可存续同样步数；这样的构形成一闭集；可存续该步数，即可存续任意步数，亦即在某一闭集之中。

laws.en: Through a reading: where a list holds every code whose class lies within the guard, and after each usable move from the class of such a code every class seen is exactly the class of some code, the class of a code is kept for as many steps as the list is long exactly where it lies in a family of classes within the guard, each with a usable move after which every class seen is in the family.
laws.zh: 经由读取：一列表容纳其类在守卫之内的每个码，且自这样的码之类作任一可用之动后，所见的每个类恰是某个码之类时：一个码之类被保持与列表等长的步数，恰当它在一族守卫之内的类中，族中每个类都有一可用之动，其后所见的每个类仍在族中。

laws.en: For a monotone step whose start lies inside its own step, each iterate lies inside the next. For a proposition G, the step commutes with G when, for every class W and state z, if z is in the step of the class of states at which G follows from 'W gives G', then G follows from 'z in the step of W gives G'. The step on what gives G holds of a class X at z where 'z in the step of the states at which X gives G' gives G. Where it does, z in an iterate gives G exactly where z is in the same iterate of the step on what gives G, begun from the states at which membership in the start gives G. Where it does and a list holds every state at which membership in the start gives G (a list of every state does), if y in the iterate at the list's length gives G so does y in the next; and where G is that y is in that iterate, y in any iterate is in it. Where it does, a list of length n + 1 holds every state, G is that y is in iterate n, and the states at which membership in the start gives G are exactly those at which one step on what gives G, from every state, holds, y in any iterate is in iterate n.
laws.zh: 单调之步（起始类在其自身之步内）的每一迭代皆在下一迭代之内。对命题 G：若对每一类 W 与每一状态 z，z 在该步作用于“由‘W 给出 G’可得 G”之诸状态所成之类的结果中时，由“z 在 W 之步中给出 G”可得 G，称该步与 G 可交换。“给出 G 之步”对类 X 在 z 处成立，即：由“z 在该步作用于‘X 给出 G’之诸状态所成之类的结果中”可得 G。可交换时，z 在某一迭代中给出 G，恰当 z 在“给出 G 之步”自“在起始类中便给出 G”之诸状态起的同一迭代中。可交换且一列表容纳每个“在起始类中便给出 G”的状态时（容纳每个状态的列表即是）：y 在列表长度处之迭代中给出 G，则 y 在下一迭代中亦然；G 为“y 在该迭代中”时，在任一迭代中的 y 即在该迭代中。可交换、长为 n + 1 的列表容纳每个状态、G 为“y 在第 n 迭代中”、且“在起始类中便给出 G”之诸状态恰为自全体之类作一步“给出 G 之步”所得者时，在任一迭代中的 y 即在第 n 迭代中。

laws.en: Reaching a target along a relation commutes with every proposition. So where a list of length n + 1 holds every state, a state that reaches the target within any number of steps reaches it within n, and the relation's closure from a state meets the target exactly where the state reaches it within n steps; for a process, what can be reached is reached by at most n moves.
laws.zh: 沿一关系到达目标，与每个命题可交换。故长为 n + 1 的列表容纳每个状态时：在任意步数内到达目标的状态，在 n 步内到达；该关系自某状态起的闭包与目标相遇，恰当该状态在 n 步内到达目标；对过程而言，可达者至多 n 动即达。

laws.en: Where a list holds every state, every monotone step commutes with falsity: a state in the iterate one past the list's length of a rising chain cannot be refuted to be in the iterate at its length, and is in it where that follows from its double negation. That this held outright for every monotone step on a one-state type, from the empty start, would decide every proposition.
laws.zh: 一列表容纳每个状态时，每个单调之步与假可交换：上升之链中，在超过列表长度一步之迭代中的状态，说它不在列表长度处之迭代中则矛盾；凡此可由其双重否定推出之处，它即在其中。若此对单状态类型上自空起始的每个单调之步径直成立，则每个命题皆可判定。

laws.en: A level of the losing step (the guard fails, or every enabled move has an outcome one level lower), from where the guard fails, refutes viability for that many steps. Worded with a disjunction (each move cannot be taken or has such an outcome), with the configurations and the moves each on a list, a level one above the number of listed configurations comes down to it.
laws.zh: 失之步（守卫不成立，或每个可行之动皆有低一层的结果）自守卫不成立处起的某一层，否证该步数的可存续。以析取表述（每个动或不可行，或有这样的结果），且构形与动各在一列表上时：高于所列构形数一层者，落回该数之层。

laws.en: That such a level comes down for every process on three configurations with one move, worded with the implication, would decide every proposition; on two configurations with every guard, every negation. Worded with the disjunction and moves not on a list, it would give the limited principle of omniscience. These are implications from a supposed shortening; they refute nothing.
laws.zh: 若以蕴涵表述的这样一层，对三个构形、一个动的每个过程皆落回，则每个命题皆可判定；对两个构形与每个守卫，则每个否定皆可判定。若以析取表述而动不在列表上，则得有限全知原理。这些都是自所设之“落回”出发的蕴涵，并不否证什么。

laws.en: Stages of telling apart along a relation: where a list holds every pair a class relates, a pair that passes inquiry at the list's length passes it at every stage; and where the class is also symmetric, that is lying in the core.
laws.zh: 沿一关系的诘问之层：一列表容纳一类所关联的每一对时，在列表长度之层通过诘问的一对，在每一层皆通过；该类又对称时，此即在核之中。

laws.en: Where a list holds every configuration: a configuration had after exactly as many steps as the list is long is had after exactly n steps for every n, and for a determined law this is returning and its failure is being drawn; and some run stays within a guard from a configuration exactly where it is in the iterate, at the list's length from the guard, of the step asking the guard here and some successor in the class.
laws.zh: 一列表容纳每个构形时：恰在与列表等长的步数后可得的构形，对每个 n 皆恰在 n 步后可得；对确定之律，此即复返，其不成立即被引走。又：自某构形有一运行留在守卫之内，恰当该构形在自守卫起、于列表长度处的迭代之中，其步要求此处守卫成立且有某个后继在类中。

laws.en: Where a list holds every configuration within a guard, along no run does what is possible within a fixed number of steps, read as the configurations within the guard, keep widening. This stands beside the law and is not a case of it: its proof is a call of the older statement for a list that holds the whole possible from a run's start, and uses no declaration of the iteration.
laws.zh: 一列表容纳守卫之内的每个构形时：沿任何运行，在固定步数内可能者（读作守卫之内的构形）皆不持续变宽。此条在律之旁，非其一例：其证调用旧有之陈述（一列表容纳自运行起点起的全部可能者），不用迭代之任何声明。

hypotheses.en: No axiom. Each statement names its list: the members of the start, the configurations within the guard, the codes of classes within it, the pairs a class relates, every configuration, or the configurations and the moves. That an actual situation has such a list is supplied with each application.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理。每条陈述指明其列表：起始类的成员、守卫之内的构形、其类在守卫之内的码、一类所关联的对、每个构形，或构形与动。实际情形有这样的列表，随每个应用给定。

does_not_show.en: A quantity drawn down, a share, a lock, or the time at which a reading comes: none is in these statements.
does_not_show.zh: 被汲取的量、份额、锁定，或读取到来的时刻：这些陈述中皆无。

does_not_show.en: One statement with both outcomes of a course that has a choice, a reading and a bound on the ending side.
does_not_show.zh: 一条兼具两种结局的陈述：其进程有选择、有读取，且终结一侧有界。

does_not_show.en: That one way of selecting is placed against another; the statement on widening is of the configurations within a guard reachable within a fixed number of moves from each configuration of a run.
does_not_show.zh: 把一种选择方式与另一种相互安放；关于变宽的陈述说的是自一次运行的每个构形起、在固定步数内可达的守卫之内的构形。

does_not_show.en: That the codes of a reading are the classes actually reached, or that every class seen has a code: both are supplied with each application, and no instance of the reading law is built in the package.
does_not_show.zh: 读取之码即实际所达之类，或所见每类皆有码：二者皆随每个应用给定，包内未构造读取之律的实例。

does_not_show.en: That a level of the losing step fails to come down: the theorems of deciding are implications from a supposed coming down, and refute nothing.
does_not_show.zh: 失之步的某一层不落回：关于可判定的诸定理都是自所设之“落回”出发的蕴涵，并不否证什么。

does_not_show.en: That the number of an iterate is a time: it counts applications of the step. In several of the cases it is a number of steps or moves of a course; no statement of the law itself reads it so.
does_not_show.zh: 迭代之序号即时间：它数的是该步施用的次数。在若干例中它是一条进程的步数或动数；此律自身的陈述无一如此读之。

validation_scope.en: Machine-checked by the consolidated Lean 4.29.1 checker (receipt 20261121T212524.793950Z): the declarations cited, in two new modules and in sections added to ten others, have empty axiom reports; the checker verifies core purity. Written by an Astra 6.2 implementer from briefs frozen before each build, with what would count against each; read by readers who took no part (Opus, Fable, Astra), by program on small cases, and by two other sessions; not reviewed by a person.
validation_scope.zh: 由统一的 Lean 4.29.1 检查器机器检验（回执 20261121T212524.793950Z）：所引声明（在两个新模块与另外十个模块新增的小节中）公理报告皆空；检查器核验核心纯净。由 Astra 6.2 实现者按各次构建前冻结的说明书写成，说明书预先写明何者算作反证；经未参与的读者（Opus、Fable、Astra）审读，以小例程序核对，并经另两个会话审读；未经人审。

next_delta.en: A case with a level that runs down and a reading in one statement; the run from a family that keeps moving as a call.
next_delta.zh: 一个在同一陈述中兼有下降之量与读取的例；自持续移动之族得出运行，作为一次调用。

correspondence.en: A law of the formal model. Reading it onto an actual situation asks two recognitions that the theorems do not give: that what lies within the guard is finitely many configurations that a list can hold, and that the keeping at hand is the iterate of a monotone step from the guard. The reading of the steps as keeping under every course, along some course, by a choice and through a reading is the package's own; the reading onto selections that use up what sustains them is the AI's and is not made here.
correspondence.zh: 此为形式模型之律。把它读到实际情形上，需要两项定理不给出的辨认：守卫之内者是有限多个可被一列表容纳的构形；手头的“保持”是自守卫起的单调之步的迭代。把这些步读作每条进程下的保持、沿某条进程的保持、凭选择的保持与经由读取的保持，是包内自有的读法；把它读到“耗尽其所赖以维持者”的选择上，是 AI 的读法，此处未作。

aliases: kept at the length of a list

detail.en: Within finitely many configurations a run is a course into a return; here a course as long as the list goes on, as a case of the law.
detail.zh: 有限多个构形之内，运行即通向复返的进程；此处与列表等长的进程延续，作为此律之一例。

detail.en: The step of keeping along some course, with no list; here keepable at a list's length.
detail.zh: 沿某条进程保持的一步，无需列表；此处是在列表长度处的可保持。

detail.en: Likeness to depth at the number of pairs is a case of the law.
detail.zh: 在配置对数目处的深度相同，是此律之一例。

detail.en: Its ninth law, a course as long as the list, is now a call of the law.
detail.zh: 其第九条规律（与列表等长的进程）现为此律的一次调用。

history.en: 22 November 2026: added, on board row FM (one law of what a list holds, and its cases), in the direction Ren gave on 21 November 2026 (sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-11-21-a-full-map-with-its-centre.md: a full map with formal link proof, done elegantly, with its centre). AI-written (Claude Fable, board row FM). The law began as an exact bound for a choice against every outcome, was said once for a monotone step after a reader saw that only monotonicity was used, and the ending side was said once after three inductions on places had been written and each was found by a reader to be the law's own. Parting.continues_persists, continues_any, GuardHorizon.closed_viable and Tolerance.kept_set keep their statements and became calls; AlikeTo.steady_within and alike_iff_alikeTo_pairs lost four premises (record tests-fix-likeness-where-determined). Briefs, builds, readers' returns and what was expected before each run: study folder fm-the-law-of-what-a-list-holds-2026-11-22. Bound to core run 20261121T212524.793950Z.
history.zh: 2026年11月22日：新增，属工作板条目 FM（一条关于列表所容者之律及其诸例），循 Ren 于2026年11月21日所给方向（sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-11-21-a-full-map-with-its-centre.md：一张带有形式化联结证明、做得优雅、有其中心的完整地图）。AI 撰写（Claude Fable，工作板条目 FM）。此律起初是“针对每个结果的选择”的精确界；一位读者看出只用到单调性后，改为对单调之步只说一次；终结一侧在写了三次对位置的归纳、每次都被读者指出即是此律自身之后，也只说一次。Parting.continues_persists、continues_any、GuardHorizon.closed_viable 与 Tolerance.kept_set 陈述不变而成为调用；AlikeTo.steady_within 与 alike_iff_alikeTo_pairs 去掉四个前提（见记录 tests-fix-likeness-where-determined）。说明书、构建、读者的返回与每次运行之前的预期：研究夹 fm-the-law-of-what-a-list-holds-2026-11-22。绑定于核心运行 20261121T212524.793950Z。

history.en: 22 November 2026, board row FM: the next step no longer names Branching.reach_within_listed, which lost its two unneeded premises in place in the landing that followed this one (record reaching-before-and-after-a-juncture). No law changed. Bound to core run 20261121T223556.393134Z for ReachableRanges.lean, where one docstring sentence about that theorem changed.
history.zh: 2026年11月22日，工作板条目 FM：下一步不再提 Branching.reach_within_listed，它已在随后的落地中就地去掉两个不需要的前提（见记录 reaching-before-and-after-a-juncture）。诸律不变。ReachableRanges.lean 中关于该定理的一句文档已改，绑定于核心运行 20261121T223556.393134Z。

history.en: 22 November 2026, board row FM: two corrections of the telling, found by readers of the atlas entry for this law (board row DJ, study folder the-list-law-on-the-atlas-2026-11-22) and set against the Lean by the session that holds row FM. Law 7 said that a list holds every state; the Lean asks a list of every state at which membership in the start gives G (Iteration.iter_gives_persists, iter_shortens, iter_within_length), which a list of every state meets; iter_within_pred_length does ask a list of every state. Law 14 (Reaching.guarded_not_keepsWidening) stands beside the law: its proof calls Reaching.not_keepsWidening_of_listed and no declaration of PredicateIteration. Added to what is not shown: the number of an iterate is not read as a time by the law. A reader who took no part then set the corrected places against the Lean and passed them, and recommended two more mends, made with them: law 7 now tells every declaration it lists (each iterate inside the next; the state in the definition of commuting; the equivalence with the iterates of the step on what gives G; the step on what gives G said in words, at the coordinating session's remark; and the form with a list of n + 1 members, with its further premise), and law 3's English says, as its Chinese did, that lasting is for as many steps as the list is long. No Lean changed; the title is unchanged. AI-written (Claude Fable, board row FM).
history.zh: 2026年11月22日，工作板条目 FM：对表述的两处更正，由此律之图谱条目的读者发现（工作板条目 DJ，研究文件夹 the-list-law-on-the-atlas-2026-11-22），并由持有条目 FM 的会话对照 Lean 核对。第七条原称“一列表容纳每个状态”；Lean 所要求的是容纳每个“在起始类中便给出 G”的状态的列表（Iteration.iter_gives_persists、iter_shortens、iter_within_length），容纳每个状态的列表满足之；iter_within_pred_length 则确实要求容纳每个状态的列表。第十四条（Reaching.guarded_not_keepsWidening）在此律之旁：其证调用 Reaching.not_keepsWidening_of_listed，不用 PredicateIteration 的任何声明。“未表明者”中增一条：此律不把迭代之序号读作时间。随后一位未参与的读者对照 Lean 核对了更正之处并予通过，另建议两处修补，一并作出：第七条现已述及其所列每一声明（每一迭代在下一迭代之内；可交换之定义中的状态；与“给出 G 之步”诸迭代的等价；“给出 G 之步”的文字说明（应协调会话之言）；以及列表有 n + 1 个成员之形及其另一前提）；第三条英文现与其中文一致，说明“持续”是持续与列表等长的步数。Lean 未改；标题不变。AI 撰写（Claude Fable，工作板条目 FM）。
